model_version: VieTrueVoice B_zalo V8.1 Inverted Dual-Seen (Full 6,445 OmniVoice)

hybrid_remediation.root_cause_note: V8.1 Run 2 initialized from V5 with 100 SPK_0001 spoof vs 75 bona and am_m=0.20 yielded <54% Gate 1 in both Run 2 Phase 1 and Phase 2, so Phase1+Phase2 grafting could not recover Gate 1 (<=33.3%). Run 2 Phase 2 still learned strong SSL OmniVoice/F5 separation (7.96% Dev Omni EER, 86.2% Gate 4 veto) with a negative classifier bias; 1-epoch frozen-SSL backend calibration on 5,100 balanced rows plus 0.25*P2 + 0.75*HeadOnly weight interpolation resolved Gate 1 (93.3%) and Gate 2 (95.2% veto / 98.8% max / 100% ctrl4) while improving Seen Omni EER (8.06% dev, 7.95% on 15,980 test).
